note: Two separate codex exec runs, concatenated. First: a worker's first turn in a linked worktree with decision 25's flags and the git common dir as a writable root; the commit succeeds. Second: the same flags with -m no-such-model; the run prints an error line and turn.failed (the message is the API's JSON error as a string) and exits 1. Both runs add -c sandbox_workspace_write.exclude_slash_tmp=true and exclude_tmpdir_env_var=true, because the scratch repository lives under /tmp, which workspace-write otherwise makes writable, and the writable-root proof would prove nothing. item.completed with item.type error is a notice, not a failure. Captured with a scrubbed environment (env -i with only HOME, PATH, USER, LOGNAME, SHELL, TERM, LANG), because the capture ran inside a Claude Code session whose CLAUDE_CODE_*/CLAUDECODE variables change how a child claude behaves (transcript saving off, messaging the parent). No ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: the subscription login was used.
